name: startTime
label: Start time
description: A UTC Time string which marks the time when the timer should start

name: endTime
label: End time
description: A string representing UTC Time when the timer should end. If this field is empty, the timer will run indefinetly. Example: '2025-08-22 12:56:00'

name: minResolution
label: Minimum resolution
description: The minimum shown resolution in the timer.

name: icon
label: Timer icon
description: The icon to be displayed infront of the timer text
